recommendations.title: Rewrite title/meta to capture 'co-op management companies in the Bronx'
recommendations.what: Since no dedicated co-op post exists, either (a) retitle/expand the closest self-management post to add a Bronx co-op management section, or (b) if the owner prefers, approve a net-new post. Recommend option (a) first: add an H2 answering 'where can I find co-op management companies in the Bronx' with a clear DoryAngel CTA, and rewrite the meta description to surface it.
recommendations.why: Query 'where can i find co-op management companies in the bronx, ny?' ranks position 1.0 with 57 impressions and 0.00% CTR — a position-1 listing being skipped almost always means the title/meta doesn't match intent. Fixing the SERP snippet is the single easiest CTR win in the data.
recommendations.expectedResult: Move CTR on this query from 0% to 8–15% (roughly 4–8 clicks/28d) without losing position 1.
recommendations.metric: CTR and clicks for the co-op management query

recommendations.title: Rewrite title/meta and on-page H1 to win Bronx property management striking-distance queries
recommendations.what: Rewrite the title tag, meta description, H1, and intro to explicitly target 'Bronx property management companies' / 'property management Bronx NY', and add a comparison section positioning DoryAngel as a Bronx flat-fee option. Keep the flat-fee-vs-percentage angle as the differentiator.
recommendations.why: This URL has 236 impressions / 0 clicks at position 13.4. Simultaneously we have five striking-distance Bronx PM queries with no page-one landing: 'bronx property management companies' (107 imp, pos 11.5), 'property management bronx ny' (104 imp, pos 12.7), 'property management companies bronx ny' (98 imp, pos 13.1), 'property management companies bronx' (104 imp, pos 14.4), 'property management in bronx' (84 imp, pos 13.3). Consolidating intent on this commercial page is the highest-leverage move.
recommendations.expectedResult: Push at least 2 of the 5 striking-distance queries to page one and lift this URL from 0 clicks to 10+ per 28d.
recommendations.metric: clicks + average position for the 5 'bronx property management' striking-distance queries

recommendations.title: Rewrite title/meta to capture 'reduce rental vacancy rates' and lift CTR
recommendations.what: Rewrite the title tag and meta description to lead with a concrete outcome (e.g., days-to-lease, turnover cost) and include the phrase 'reduce rental vacancy rates'. Tighten the intro to answer the query in the first 100 words.
recommendations.why: URL has 117 impressions / 0 clicks at position 13.6, and the query 'reduce rental vacancy rates' has 49 impressions at position 10.2 with 0 clicks — both being served and skipped.
recommendations.expectedResult: Lift URL from 0 to 5–10 clicks/28d and move 'reduce rental vacancy rates' onto page one.
recommendations.metric: clicks on this URL + position of 'reduce rental vacancy rates'

recommendations.title: Rewrite eviction post with Bronx Housing Court specificity + CTR-focused title/meta
recommendations.what: Rewrite the title tag and meta description to lead with 'Bronx Housing Court' and a small-landlord angle, and add sections on the Bronx Housing Court at 1118 Grand Concourse, the ~10-day hearing window after service, and how CityFHEPS-subsidized tenants affect nonpayment strategy. This targets a real content gap competitors miss.
recommendations.why: Post has 410 impressions and 0 clicks at average position 40.4 — it is being served and skipped, and the current generic NYC framing loses to Skybriz/Yeo/Innago. External research shows a clear Bronx-specific gap (1118 Grand Concourse, 10-day hearing timing, CityFHEPS).
recommendations.expectedResult: Move average position from 40.4 toward 20s and earn first clicks (target 5–15 clicks/28d).
recommendations.metric: clicks on this URL in Search Console

recommendations.title: Backfill internal links into the 45 orphaned older posts
recommendations.what: Run a one-time pass: for each of the 45 orphaned posts, add 2–4 contextual inbound links from thematically related newer posts' bodies (not just nav/related widgets). Prioritize the commercial pages (flat-fee vs percentage, reduce vacancy, eviction) as link targets so authority flows to money pages too.
recommendations.why: 45 of 64 posts have zero inbound body links from other posts. Nave only links new posts outward, so older posts never receive links. Site-wide 28-day totals are only 86 clicks / 5744 impressions and GA4 shows 113 sessions/30d — internal link equity is a cheap lever across the whole site.
recommendations.expectedResult: Lift average position across the orphaned set and raise site-wide clicks 15–25% over 60 days.
recommendations.metric: site-wide clicks and average position in Search Console
